entities.name: PMID:27036593
observations: Induced-error testing in 21 DMLC IMRT QA measurements found common 3%/3 mm, 10% threshold, 90%-passing criteria could miss errors up to 15% MU and ±1 cm random MLC in some cases; broadening penumbra remained difficult to detect.

entities.name: PMID:29481698
observations: Testing 76 plans, including deliberately modified target/OAR errors, suggested 3%/2 mm with 95% pass and 90% fail thresholds, with DVH review for intermediate results, could improve clinically relevant error detection.

entities.name: PMID:36988665
observations: In 40 thoracic plans with induced delivery errors, portal-dose image features and machine learning classified five error categories with 99.30% test accuracy; evidence is from induced errors, not clinical outcome prediction.

entities.name: Conventional IMRT QA misses errors
observations: Conventional gamma passing alone does not reliably exclude substantial induced delivery errors; detection depends on error type, plan, device, and analysis criteria.

entities.name: Enhanced PSQA workflow
observations: Case-specific sensitivity analysis, clinically informed gamma thresholds, and DVH review of questionable plans can improve error triage; validation does not establish prediction of patient outcomes.

entities.name: Traumatic pneumothorax treatment
observations: With clinically suspected traumatic pneumothorax and preserved blood pressure, prompt tube thoracostomy is definitive; needle decompression is a temporizing measure for tension physiology.
